You are a planning expert. Given an asynchronous planning problem, extract the dependency graph.

For each step, identify:
1. A short snake_case name (e.g., "boil_water", "add_pasta") — use ONLY lowercase letters, digits, and underscores
2. The duration in SECONDS (convert minutes/hours/days if needed: 1 min=60s, 1 hour=3600s, 1 day=86400s)
3. The DIRECT predecessors — steps that MUST complete before this step can start

CRITICAL RULES:
- List ALL direct predecessor steps in "depends_on". A missing dependency will cause a wrong answer.
- If a step has no prerequisites, use an empty list [].
- Every name in "depends_on" MUST exactly match a "name" defined in the same "steps" list.
- Capture ONLY dependencies stated in the problem. Do NOT add extra constraints.

SELF-CHECK before returning:
1. Re-read EVERY ordering constraint in the problem. Is each one captured in some step's "depends_on"?
2. For every entry in any "depends_on" list, confirm that exact name appears as a "name" in the steps list.

Return JSON with key "responses" (list of dicts). Each dict must have key "steps" (list of step dicts).
Each step dict must include:
- "name": snake_case string identifier
- "duration": integer seconds
- "depends_on": list of step name strings (direct predecessors only)

Example:
{
  "responses": [{
    "steps": [
      {"name": "boil_water",  "duration": 300,  "depends_on": []},
      {"name": "add_pasta",   "duration": 600,  "depends_on": ["boil_water"]},
      {"name": "make_sauce",  "duration": 900,  "depends_on": []},
      {"name": "combine",     "duration": 60,   "depends_on": ["add_pasta", "make_sauce"]}
    ]
  }]
}

Here is an asynchronous planning problem.

To season baked fish, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Sharpen the filleting knife (120 seconds)
Step 2. Thaw the frozen fish fillets in a cold water bath (2700 seconds)
Step 3. Zest two fresh lemons (180 seconds)
Step 4. Arrange the seasoned fillets on a parchment-lined baking sheet (300 seconds)
Step 5. Mince four cloves of fresh garlic (240 seconds)
Step 6. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit (900 seconds)
Step 7. Garnish the fish with fresh parsley sprigs (60 seconds)
Step 8. Melt a tablespoon of unsalted butter (30 seconds)
Step 9. Prepare a small bowl of cracked black pepper (60 seconds)
Step 10. Measure out half a teaspoon of smoked paprika (30 seconds)
Step 11. Scale the fish skin if necessary (600 seconds)
Step 12. Pat the fish fillets completely dry with paper towels (120 seconds)
Step 13. Mix the dry spices together in a ramekin (60 seconds)
Step 14. Infuse olive oil with a pinch of saffron (3600 seconds)
Step 15. Rinse the fish under cold running water (60 seconds)
Step 16. Apply a light coating of oil to the fish skin (120 seconds)
Step 17. Chop fresh dill finely (180 seconds)
Step 18. Retrieve the spice rack from the pantry (120 seconds)
Step 19. Pour high-quality extra virgin olive oil into a saucer (60 seconds)
Step 20. Sprinkle a final pinch of sea salt over the fillets (30 seconds)
Step 21. Clean the kitchen counter workspace (600 seconds)
Step 22. Score the skin of the fish to prevent curling (180 seconds)
Step 23. Remove the fish from the water bath and check for pin bones (600 seconds)
Step 24. Gather all fresh herbs from the garden (900 seconds)
Step 25. Place the knife back in the drawer (30 seconds)
Step 26. Peel the skins off the garlic cloves (120 seconds)
Step 27. Wash all produce and citrus (300 seconds)
Step 28. Sanitize the cutting board used for herbs (300 seconds)
Step 29. Select the freshest fillets from the refrigerator (120 seconds)
Step 30. Open a new container of kosher salt (60 seconds)
Step 31. Squeeze the juice of the zested lemons (120 seconds)
Step 32. Inspect the fish for any scales or debris (240 seconds)
Step 33. Set the oven timer for the preheating alert (10 seconds)
Step 34. Brush the herb-infused butter onto the fish (180 seconds)
Step 35. Soften the butter at room temperature (1200 seconds)
Step 36. Toast a few fennel seeds in a dry pan (180 seconds)
Step 37. Sort through the dried spice jars (300 seconds)
Step 38. Measure a tablespoon of capers (60 seconds)
Step 39. Steep the saffron in a small amount of warm water (600 seconds)
Step 40. Buy a fresh bottle of white wine for the marinade (1800 seconds)
Step 41. Clarify the melted butter (300 seconds)
Step 42. Wipe the workspace dry of any fish juices (120 seconds)
Step 43. Whisk together the garlic, lemon, and butter (120 seconds)
Step 44. Grind the toasted fennel seeds (120 seconds)
Step 45. Slice the lemons into thin rounds (120 seconds)
Step 46. Prepare a bed of sliced onions for the fish (300 seconds)
Step 47. Organize all necessary ingredients on the counter (600 seconds)
Step 48. Place the baking sheet into the center rack of the oven (30 seconds)
Step 49. Toss the chopped herbs together in a small bowl (60 seconds)
Step 50. Crush the garlic cloves slightly with the flat of a blade (60 seconds)
Step 51. Measure out the dried oregano (30 seconds)
Step 52. Combine the herbs with the dry spice mix (60 seconds)
Step 53. Create a crust by mixing the spices with breadcrumbs (240 seconds)
Step 54. Remove the fish from its packaging (60 seconds)
Step 55. Lay the fillets flat on a clean plate (60 seconds)
Step 56. Strain the saffron oil (120 seconds)
Step 57. Rub the dry spice mixture onto the flesh side (180 seconds)
Step 58. Mix lemon juice with a hint of honey (120 seconds)
Step 59. Take the butter out of the refrigerator (60 seconds)
Step 60. Lightly salt the skin side of the fish (30 seconds)
Step 61. Inventory the spice cabinet for missing items (600 seconds)
Step 62. Press the minced garlic into the fish (120 seconds)
Step 63. Grate a small amount of fresh ginger (120 seconds)
Step 64. Combine the ginger and lemon zest (60 seconds)
Step 65. Slice the garlic cloves into thin slivers (180 seconds)
Step 66. Prepare a side of steamed asparagus (600 seconds)
Step 67. Wash the ginger root (60 seconds)
Step 68. Finely dice a small shallot (180 seconds)
Step 69. Marinate the fish in the oil and shallot mixture (900 seconds)
Step 70. Measure out a teaspoon of dried thyme (30 seconds)
Step 71. Mix the shallots into the butter (120 seconds)
Step 72. Place lemon slices on top of the fish (60 seconds)
Step 73. Pick the leaves off the thyme stems (300 seconds)
Step 74. Prepare a splash of white wine for the pan (60 seconds)
Step 75. Discard any fish trimmings (60 seconds)
Step 76. Measure out the sea salt (30 seconds)
Step 77. Dust the fish with a final layer of paprika (30 seconds)
Step 78. Coat the fish in the breadcrumb spice crust (300 seconds)
Step 79. Mix the capers into the butter sauce (60 seconds)
Step 80. Rub the fillets with a small amount of kosher salt (60 seconds)
Step 81. Sprinkle the chopped dill over the fish (30 seconds)
Step 82. Locate the measuring spoons (120 seconds)
Step 83. Drizzle the white wine over the fillets (30 seconds)
Step 84. Add a final squeeze of lemon over the seasoned fish (20 seconds)
Step 85. Chop a handful of fresh cilantro (180 seconds)
Step 86. Clean the lemon zester (120 seconds)
Step 87. Sterilize the herb scissors (300 seconds)
Step 88. Mix the cilantro into the breadcrumb topping (60 seconds)
Step 89. Wash the parsley and pat it dry (180 seconds)
Step 90. Combine all liquid marinade ingredients (180 seconds)
Step 91. Allow the seasoned fish to rest for a few minutes (300 seconds)
Step 92. Grind whole peppercorns into a powder (120 seconds)
Step 93. Toss the thyme leaves with the breadcrumbs (60 seconds)
Step 94. Check the internal temperature of the raw fish (60 seconds)
Step 95. Slice the onions into rings (240 seconds)
Step 96. Measure out the honey (60 seconds)
Step 97. Finely chop the toasted fennel seeds (120 seconds)
Step 98. Sharpen the kitchen shears (300 seconds)
Step 99. Double-check the seasoning coverage (60 seconds)
Step 100. Measure the breadcrumbs into a bowl (60 seconds)
